_readme: Parity scenarios: our engine vs Craft of Exile's Calculator (craftofexile.com, PoE1, patch 3.29).
poc_p = per-attempt success probability from poc/engine.mjs (see poc/results.json for the run that produced it).
coe_p = the same number read off Craft of Exile. null until filled in. Milestone 2 passes when |poc_p - coe_p| / coe_p <= 0.05 for every scenario.
Tiers are 1 = best, counted over the mods that can roll on that base at that ilvl. Essence-forced mods get a value-based tier (see engine.mjs buildPool).
Groups are RePoE mod group ids. Sides: prefix | suffix. A kOf pick means any k of the options.
All scenarios start from a fresh base of the stated ilvl, no influence, no fractured/crafted mods.

coe_p read from craftofexile.com (3.29 data) on 05/09/2026 via the Calculator. amethyst is derived by inclusion-exclusion: P(fire AND cold)=0.176%, same for the other pairs by symmetry, P(all three)=0.003565%, so P(>=2 of 3)=3*0.1761-2*0.003565=0.521%. titan-zeal-life2 was also run through CoE's Simulator (300,000 essences): 7.321% +-0.093; the Calculator is an approximation for essences, the Simulator is the emulation, and our engine agrees with the Simulator within noise.

scenarios.coe_setup: Astral Plate ilvl 86, Chaos Orb. Target: maximum Life T1 or T2 (+160 or better) AND Fire Resistance T1 or T2 (+42% or better).
Same as above with Orb of Alchemy. Sanity check: p must equal the chaos scenario.
Astral Plate ilvl 86, Deafening Essence of Greed (forces +160-174 Life). Target: Fire Resistance T1 or T2.
Astral Plate ilvl 86, Deafening Essence of Anger (forces +46-48% Fire Res). Target: maximum Life T1 or T2.
Astral Plate ilvl 86, Chaos Orb. Target: maximum Life T1 (+175-189) only.
Titan Greaves ilvl 86, Chaos Orb. Target: Movement Speed T1 or T2 (30% or 35%) AND maximum Life T1 or T2.
Titan Greaves ilvl 86, Deafening Essence of Zeal (forces 32% Movement Speed, a prefix). Target: maximum Life T1 or T2.
Vaal Axe ilvl 86, Chaos Orb. Target: increased Physical Damage (pure, not the hybrid with accuracy) T1 or T2. Low p: 2M rolls.
Vaal Axe ilvl 86, Deafening Essence of Zeal (forces 28-30% Attack Speed, a suffix). Target: increased Physical Damage (pure) T1 or T2. Low p: 2M rolls.

Amethyst Ring ilvl 86, Chaos Orb. Target: any two of Fire/Cold/Lightning Resistance at T1 or T2. Use CoE's 'any N of' target group if available, otherwise sum the three pair cases (minus the triple counted twice).
